page.overview:
Who is Hana?

Hana is an academy student of Konohagakure who appears in Naruto Shippūden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 4.

Hana is a kind, young girl who takes a liking to Shino Aburame.

While practising jutsu with Yuki, Mabo and Toshi, Hana loses track of time while practising her Cloak of Invisibility Technique. Naruto Uzumaki and Shino Aburame find her and have her return to Yuki. Naruto and Shino soon return to Hana, who is now with Yuki and Toshi. They ask about Mabo's secret code, but the children don't recall and give the two shinobi a hint. Naruto and Shino soon return with Mabo and take their leave with some words of farewell. Iruka returns telling the group it's time for them to reflect on their actions.

Naruto meets Hana and the other children again later. They tell him about the things Iruka taught them. They ask Naruto to play a game of hide-and-seek around the world with them while they practise their Cloak of Invisibility Technique and he accepts. Shikamaru Nara and Gaara are later included in the training against their will.
